drafted_from: tool:run-a-composio-action's own row and the stand-in test tools/composio-connection/test/run-a-composio-action.test.mjs; one live read-only proxied GET /me for a connected Instagram account answered its username on Nov 20 2026
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run this Composio action for my account", with the action (or the app request), the account's connection id and its user id.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: the caller names the account and the action.
instructions: 1. Find the account's connection id and owning user id with tool:list-my-connected-accounts.
2. Call tool:run-a-composio-action with {account_id, user_id, project_id when the vault holds a user key, and either action + arguments or proxy {endpoint, method, body}}.
3. Read data (and status for a proxy request). An action that publishes or sends does so: put your checks before this step.

worked_examples.title: Read a connected Instagram account's name
worked_examples.ask: Read my Instagram account's name through Composio
worked_examples.given: A stand-in Composio answer in the test.
